data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root fa-w-w, meaning 'to win, be successful, or conquer'. In Islamic tradition, Fawza symbolizes the triumph of good over evil and the reward of righteous deeds. The name Fawza carries the meaning “Successful, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fawza usually hope their child will grow to embody successful, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fawza total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
